title: Police officer indicted for fabricating, distributing deepfake videos of acquaintances

reading.body:
This is a case of AI used to fabricate sexual imagery of real, identifiable people, made with consumer AI apps rather than any specialised system. The material was produced and distributed through Telegram chat rooms, so the deployment context is a private messaging platform with no content review and no victim consent. The failure is not that a model malfunctioned but that image generation was turned on acquaintances, and the resulting fakes were circulated as if real.

Detection came from an undercover investigation by a different police force into the chat room, not from any safeguard in the tools used or any check by the platform. Catching this earlier would have required either platform-level detection of synthetic sexual material or a reporting route for the people depicted. The officer's prior suspended prosecution and his later hiring are separate administrative matters, and the reports describe them as such.

What is not established is intent beyond the alleged acts, and the station itself has said it cannot confirm the detailed charges or investigation details. An indictment is not a verdict.

reports.title: 'Suspension of prosecution for sexual offense' police officer, production and distribution of AI sexual exploitation material... indicted and detained
Police officer indicted for fabricating, distributing deepfake videos of acquaintances

summary:
A South Korean police officer was arrested for making and sharing AI-generated sexual exploitation material. The officer, an A-rank constable at Seoul's Dongdaemun Police Station, was caught after Busan police ran an undercover investigation into a Telegram chat room. He was found with about 5,600 illegal videos, including 2,600 fake videos, 1,600 child and teen sexual exploitation materials, and 1,300 illegal recordings. He also made about 400 fake nude images of acquaintances using AI apps and distributed dozens of fake videos in Telegram rooms. He had previously received a suspended prosecution for a similar case before joining the police in April 2024, and his crimes continued after he joined.

The Dongdaemun Police Station said the officer was put on standby duty right after being notified of the investigation and is now removed from his position. The station said it cannot confirm the detailed charges or investigation details.
